en: How do I delete my Ebda Chat account?

steps: Wallet > Delete this store's WhatsApp account
Tick giving up balance if any
Confirm; 14 days; cancel any time before
edgeCases: Open refund/payment in flight delays deletion
Balance grew during wait: re-approval needed
Top-ups and purchases frozen while pending
Operator-started deletion can only be cancelled by operator
Payment/refund records kept without the store name
Does not cancel anything at Meta
gaps: Placed at the bottom of the Wallet screen, hard to find; no dedicated Settings/Account area
assistantNote: cancel during the 14 days; after that irreversible
